name: Venom

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.True Strike: Saldırılar Zırh, Direnç, Otomatik Blok ve Kaçışı (Evade) yok sayar.

signatureAbility:
Aggressive Symbiosis
Rapid evolutionary changes to the Symbiote grant Venom an additional Genetic Memory Buff at the start of the fight, as well as a 34.95 - 100% chance to gain a third Buff to start the fight.
Venom's Genetic Memory Buffs also gain 5.08 - 20% Potency.

abilitySections.title: Genetic Memory
content: Venom has a Klyntar Mutation Buff that refreshes itself every 9 seconds. When this effect activates, a random Genetic Memory Buff is gained from the list below. If Venom becomes Incinerated, the Mutation Buff is Nullified. Max Genetic Memory Buffs: 7.

abilitySections.title: Klyntar Buff
content: Venom's Klyntar Mutation Buff provides +1,583.85 Attack and gains additional properties based on Venom's opponent.
Spider-Verse Heroes: All attacks ignore Passive Evade effects.
Tech Champions: Power Burn & Power Drain Immunity.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: A heavy strike inflicts Armor Break, reducing the opponent's Armor rating by 916.67 for 11 seconds. Landing this attack also causes Venom to randomize his most recent Genetic Memory Buff.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits
content: Critical Hits lacerate opponents with a 80% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing 7,919.25 damage over 4.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Opponent Below 18% Health
content: Venom's bloodlust grants him True Strike and Unblockable Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each strike has a 55% chance to steal a Buff and feed it to the symbiote, Nullifying the Buff, triggering a Genetic Memory Buff and healing Venom for 5,971.76 Health.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Venom is unleashed, converting all Genetic Memory Buffs into Fury Buffs, each increasing Attack by 2,322.98 for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: An ambush attack grants Venom +5% damage during this attack for each Buff Venom has.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Aggressive Symbiosis
content: Rapid evolutionary changes to the Symbiote grant Venom an additional Genetic Memory Buff at the start of the fight, as well as a 34.95 - 100% chance to gain a third Buff to start the fight.
Venom's Genetic Memory Buffs also gain 5.08 - 20% Potency.
